title: 芬恩与智慧鲑鱼
summary: 芬恩替诗人芬尼加斯烹煮寻获的智慧鲑鱼，不慎烫伤手指，吮吸时尝到鱼汁。诗人发现预言指向的并非自己，便让少年吃鱼，智慧从此与芬恩相随。
paragraphs: 年少的芬恩还没有成为费奥纳勇士的首领时，曾向诗人芬尼加斯学习。依照爱尔兰少年事迹中的著名讲述，诗人多年守候博因河，等待一条能带来智慧的鲑鱼。他终于捕到鱼，便交给少年烹煮，特别叮嘱不可先尝一口，希望把长久追寻的智慧留给自己。
芬恩看守炉火，留意鱼皮不要烧焦。鱼身鼓起一处水泡，他伸出拇指按住，滚烫的油汁却灼伤手指。他本能地把拇指放进口中止痛，没有想到这个细小动作已经让他尝到鲑鱼。端鱼上桌以后，诗人追问他是否吃过，他如实说自己没有吃肉，只曾吮过烫伤的手指。
诗人又问少年的名字，听见芬恩之名，明白关于智慧归属的预言落在眼前的学生身上，而不是久候河边的自己。他让芬恩吃下鲑鱼，完成所得。此后遇到疑难，芬恩把拇指放到齿边，便能获得隐秘知识；这段成长故事解释了英雄的洞察力，而非一场靠武力赢得的比赛。

en.title: Fionn and the Salmon of Knowledge
en.summary: Young Fionn cooks the salmon that his teacher has long sought. A burnt thumb brings an accidental taste, revealing who was meant to receive its knowledge. The disappointed poet recognizes the prophecy and allows his pupil to finish the fish.
paragraphs: Before becoming leader of the Fianna, young Fionn studied with the poet Finnéces, also known as Finegas. In the familiar Irish boyhood tale, the teacher had waited beside the River Boyne for a salmon carrying extraordinary knowledge. When he finally caught it, he asked his pupil to cook the fish, expressly forbidding him to taste any of its flesh.

While watching the cooking, Fionn noticed a blister rising on the salmon’s skin. He pressed it with his thumb, burning himself, and instinctively put the injured finger into his mouth. When the fish was ready, his teacher asked whether he had eaten any. Fionn answered honestly: he had taken no meat, but had sucked his thumb to soothe the burn.

After asking the boy’s name, the poet recognized that the promised recipient of the salmon’s knowledge was his pupil, not himself. He gave Fionn the fish to eat, completing the transfer he had hoped to secure. Thereafter, putting his thumb to his tooth could reveal hidden knowledge. The episode explains the hero’s insight through an accidental act rather than a martial victory.

title: 里安农的考验与归来的孩子
summary: 里安农的婴儿夜间失踪，侍女害怕受罚，杀犬伪造她吞食孩子的证据。她被迫在宫门受辱，直到特尔农带回救下的男孩，失踪真相才使王后恢复名誉。
paragraphs: 在威尔士《马比诺吉昂》第一支中，里安农嫁给普伊尔以后，终于生下众人期盼的继承人。六名妇女轮流守护婴儿，却在一夜之间全都睡去，醒来时发现摇篮已空。她们害怕承担失职的后果，便杀死一只幼犬，把血涂在熟睡王后的脸上，诬称母亲吞食了自己的孩子。
里安农否认指控，却没有证人替她辩明。宫廷决定让她受罚七年：坐在宫门旁的上马石边，向来客复述那项罪名，并提出背他们入内。与此同时，领主特尔农守候自家母马产驹，看见巨爪伸来抢夺，挥剑将它砍断；追到门外时，他发现一个被遗留的男婴，便带回抚养。
男孩渐渐长大，容貌越来越像普伊尔。特尔农听说王后失子受罚的遭遇，把线索联系起来，带着孩子前往宫廷说明发现经过。男孩的身世终于得到确认，里安农不必再承担虚假的罪名，儿子后来取名普里德里。这场重逢提前结束惩罚，并不意味着她曾经真的伤害过婴儿。

en.title: Rhiannon’s Ordeal and the Returning Child
en.summary: When Rhiannon’s baby vanishes, frightened attendants manufacture evidence that she killed him. She must endure a humiliating punishment at the palace gate. Elsewhere, Teyrnon rescues a mysterious infant whose growing resemblance to Pwyll eventually reunites the family and clears her.
paragraphs: In the First Branch of the Welsh Mabinogi, Rhiannon and Pwyll finally had the heir their household awaited. Six women watched over the baby, but all fell asleep one night. On waking, they found him gone. Fearing punishment for their negligence, they killed a puppy, smeared its blood on the sleeping queen, and accused her of devouring her own child.

Unable to prove her innocence, Rhiannon was sentenced to seven years beside the mounting block outside the palace. She had to recount the accusation and offer to carry visitors inside. Meanwhile, Teyrnon guarded his mare during foaling. He cut off a monstrous claw reaching for the newborn foal, pursued its owner, and discovered an abandoned baby boy, whom his household raised.

As the boy grew, Teyrnon noticed his resemblance to Pwyll. Hearing about the missing royal child and Rhiannon’s disgrace, he connected the events and brought his foster son to court. His account enabled the family to recognize the child, later named Pryderi. Rhiannon’s punishment ended before its full term: the reunion exposed a false accusation, not a mother’s actual violence.
